response.summary: Overall notebook quality is mixed: it runs end-to-end and reports results consistently, but it contains a critical methodological error that undermines the evaluation. The most important finding is data leakage: feature scaling is fit on the full dataset before the train/test split, so test information influences preprocessing and the reported performance is not trustworthy. In interview, ask her to explain how she would prevent leakage (e.g., fit scalers/encoders only on training via a pipeline) and how she would evaluate a churn model under class imbalance (prioritizing recall/PR-AUC and choosing thresholds/costs rather than relying on accuracy). Also verify she can interpret the current results: despite 0.853 accuracy, churn recall is very low (0.119), so the model would miss most churners and the “production-ready” claim is not supported.
